AKI_SISTER_ENCHANTMENT_RED_LEAF_MARK_ENC:
Lasts for 1 turn.
When you play or exhaust a card with [orange]"Red Leaf Mark"[/orange], gain 1 stack of [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold].
Can be overwritten by [orange]"Sweet Potato Mark"[/orange].
Removed when sent to the [gold]discard pile[/gold] or [gold]exhaust pile[/gold].
AKI_SISTER_ENCHANTMENT_SWEET_POTATO_MARK:
Lasts for 1 turn.
When you play or exhaust a card with [orange]"Sweet Potato Mark"[/orange], gain 1 stack of [gold]Fragrance[/gold].
Can be overwritten by [orange]"Red Leaf Mark"[/orange].
Removed when sent to the [gold]discard pile[/gold] or [gold]exhaust pile[/gold].
